- Give folders and videos their own layout and grid size, so a folder list can sit next to a video grid
- Add an independent configuration switch to quick settings, so a folder keeps its own layout, sorting and display fields that its subfolders inherit and may override
- Point out in quick settings when the edits change the global defaults, and when the folder still inherits an independent configuration from a parent
- Support per-folder quick settings on cloud servers as well
- Show the browsing mode in the quick settings of the local root only

---

- 文件夹和视频可以各自设置布局和网格尺寸，同一页里可以让文件夹用列表、视频用网格
- 快捷设置新增独立配置开关，打开后该目录拥有自己的布局、排序和显示字段，子目录会沿用它们，也能再单独覆盖
- 快捷设置会说明当前改动写入的是全局默认配置，以及当前目录是否仍继承上级目录的独立配置
- 网络服务器的浏览同样支持按目录单独配置这些快捷设置
- 浏览模式只在本地根目录的快捷设置中提供
